The stock of CHANGYOU.COM Limited – American Depositary Shares (NASDAQ:CYOU) registered a decrease of 12.83% in short interest. CYOU’s total short interest was 417,900 shares in December as published by FINRA. Its down 12.83% from 479,400 shares, reported previously. With 290,600 shares average volume, it will take short sellers 1 days to cover their CYOU’s short positions. The short interest to CHANGYOU.COM Limited – American Depositary Shares’s float is 2.61%.
The stock decreased 1.08% or $0.2 during the last trading session, reaching $18.25. About 139,231 shares traded. Changyou.com Limited (NASDAQ:CYOU) has declined 22.28% downtrending. It has underperformed by 22.28% the S&P500.
